48R6DAB: Cortech Anchor 6-Seat Round Laminate Table with Molded Seats
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-anchor-table-6-seat-round-top
Manufacturer pages: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/tables/anchor-tables/, https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/tables/anchor-2-tables/
Spec sheets: Anchor (J-leg), Anchor 2 (U-leg), Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Anchor 6-Seat Round Laminate Table with Molded Seats – 48R6DAB
Current H1: Cortech Anchor 6‑Seat Round Top Table - Model 48R6DAB
Subtitle: Fixed Group Seating Table with 48” Round Laminate Top and Bolt-Down Steel Frame
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 48R6DAB Round Top Anchor Table
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Anchor 6-Seat Round Laminate Table with Molded Seats is a fixed group seating table for dayrooms and dining areas in correctional and behavioral healthcare facilities. The 48” round laminate top and six molded seats are joined to a continuous welded steel frame that bolts to the floor, so the table and seats stay in place.
The seats are rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene and attach to the frame through molded-in threaded steel inserts and tamper-resistant hardware. The seamless laminate top has a rounded edge for safety and comfort, and an ADA version is made with one fewer leg and seat for wheelchair access.
Seats: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene, with molded-in threaded steel inserts for a tamper-resistant, steel-to-steel attachment to the frame
Top: Seamless laminate top with high impact resistance and a rounded edge for safety and comfort; attaches to the frame with tamper-resistant screws
Frame: Continuous seam welded 3” diameter, 14-gauge powder coated steel with 11-gauge steel seat supports
Legs: J-leg (Anchor) or U-leg (Anchor 2) frame
Seating: 6 seats
Top Size: 48” round
Weight: 150 lbs
ADA Version: Made with one fewer leg and seat (5 seats) for wheelchair access; 125 lbs
Top Color: Gray (custom colors available on request)
Seat Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Easy Cleaning: Easy to clean and maintain
Warranty: 3-year warranty on the steel legs (must be bolted down); 5-year warranty on the laminate top
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
48R6DAB – 48” Round Top: 6 seats, 150 lbs
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Must be bolted to the floor; drill holes at least 2” deep and use concrete anchors
Assembly: Required; the top and seats attach to the frame with tamper-resistant screws (T40 bit); see Cortech instructions
[H2] Applications
The Anchor 6-Seat Round Table suits dayrooms and dining areas where tables and seats must stay fixed in place and stand up to continuous use.
Typical applications include:
Correctional dayrooms and dining halls
Jails and detention centers
Behavioral healthcare facilities and other secure group areas
Explore Anchortex's Prison and Detention Furniture and Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Anchor Tables
Cortech Anchor Tables are fixed group seating tables for dayrooms and dining areas in correctional and behavioral healthcare facilities. Each table has a laminate top and rotationally molded seats on a continuous welded steel frame that bolts to the floor.
Anchor Tables come in four sizes:
4-Seat Table: 42” round or 42”×42” square top
6-Seat Round Table: 48” round top
6-Seat Rectangle Table: 30”×72” top
8-Seat Rectangle Table: 30”×96” top
Every size can be made with one fewer leg and seat for ADA wheelchair access, and the frame comes with J-legs (Anchor) or U-legs (Anchor 2).
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (56 characters): Cortech Anchor 6-Seat Round Table - 48R6DAB at Anchortex
Meta description (150 characters): Shop the Cortech Anchor 6-seat round table. A 48 inch round laminate top with six molded seats on a bolt-down welded steel frame, with an ADA version.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Anchor Tables" section as the 4-Seat Table tab. Any changes you make there will be applied here too.
H1: I added "Laminate" and "with Molded Seats" so it reads the same way as the other Anchor Table pages, and removed "Model."
Top size: your current page says "Round top - 42" diameter." The model number 48R6DAB and the Cortech spec sheets say 48”, so I used 48”.
J-leg or U-leg: Cortech sells the Anchor Table with J-legs and the Anchor 2 Table with U-legs, with the same sizes, weights, and warranty. Your page offers "J-Leg or U-Leg," so I linked both Cortech pages and spec sheets above.
Model numbers: the Cortech spec sheets do not list model numbers for the Anchor Tables, so I kept yours.
Weight: your variant is set to 255 lbs. The Cortech spec sheets say 150 lbs (125 lbs for the ADA version), so I used 150 lbs.
Warranty: your current page says "3 year factory warranty, must be bolted down." The Cortech spec sheets say 3 years on the steel legs (must be bolted down) and 5 years on the laminate top, so I used that.
Seat colors: your current page lists 10 colors. The Cortech spec sheets list 18, and also give a gray top. I used the Cortech list.
Dimensions: Cortech does not publish the overall height or footprint of the Anchor Tables, so I gave the top size only.
